rules.accepted_credit_types: Any program or activity that enhances the veterinarian's knowledge, skills or abilities to practice veterinary medicine (incl. expert consultation, self-study with testing); providers encouraged to seek AAVSB RACE approval
rules.alternatives: Waived for impaired veterinarians, during active military duty in a national emergency, and for institutional licenses; no other hardship waivers or extensions.
rules.audit_note: Keep a CE documentation file; audited from time to time and in complaint investigations.
rules.notes: Licenses expire every June 30; CE year runs July 1 - June 30. 1 clock hour = 60 minutes. No online limit stated.
